text: “Put the trumpet to your lips! An eagle is over the house of the Lord because the people have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.
they choose princes without my approval. With their silver and gold they make idols for themselves to their own destruction.
My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity?
This calf—a craftsman has made it; it is not God. It will be broken in pieces, that calf of Samaria.
